briefdescription.para: Converts a one-based CSI parameter to a zero-based grid index.

detaileddescription.para: CSI sequences use one-based row/column numbering (e.g. ESC[1;1H means row 0, column 0 internally). This helper performs the conversion and clamps the result to a minimum of 0.

parameterdescription.para: Index of the parameter to read (0-based within params).
Value to use if the parameter is absent or zero.

briefdescription.para: Converts a zero-based grid index to a one-based CSI parameter value.

detaileddescription.para: Used when building device response strings (e.g. CPR — Cursor Position Report) that must use one-based coordinates per the VT specification.

briefdescription.para: CSI (Control Sequence Introducer) sequence dispatch, cursor, scroll, and report handlers.

detaileddescription.para: This translation unit implements Video::applyCSI() and the cursor, scroll, and report CSI handler functions. Mode handlers live in VideoMode.cpp. A CSI sequence has the form:
where <params> is a semicolon-separated list of decimal integers, <intermediates> is zero or more bytes in 0x20–0x2F, and <final> is a single byte in 0x40–0x7E that identifies the command.

Dispatch table applyCSI() switches on the final byte and delegates to a dedicated handler for each recognised sequence. Private sequences (those with ? as the first intermediate byte) are routed to handlePrivateMode() for DECSET/DECRST processing.
